title: Optimizing a Freelance Profile for High Conversion
short_description: Create a professional freelance profile bio and tagline that attracts clients.
business_problem: New freelancers often struggle to get noticed because their profiles are too generic and don't highlight their value clearly.

instruction.overview: You will draft a complete profile description for a platform like Upwork or LinkedIn focused on a specific service niche.
steps: Select a specific skill or niche you want to offer as a freelancer.
Write a catchy tagline that explains exactly what you do.
Draft a 300-word bio focusing on client benefits rather than just your history.
List 5-10 specific tags/skills that match your chosen niche.
Include a clear call to action at the end of the bio.
deliverables: A document containing the tagline, bio, and skill list.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on how well the bio speaks to the client's needs.

title: Creating Professional Pitch Templates for Cold Outreach
short_description: Write two distinct pitch templates to contact potential clients for freelance work.
business_problem: Freelancers need a systematic way to reach out to clients that feels personalized yet efficient.

instruction.overview: Create two email templates: one for a cold outreach and one for replying to a job posting.
steps: Research common client pain points in a chosen industry.
Draft a 'Cold Outreach' template that introduces your services.
Draft a 'Job Response' template that addresses a specific hypothetical project requirement.
Ensure both templates include placeholders for personalization (e.g., [Client Name]).
deliverables: One document with two separate templates.
submission_requirements: Submit as a text document or PDF.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Avoid templates that sound too robotic or generic.

title: Freelance Service Catalog and Rate Card
short_description: Build a structured list of services and pricing for a freelance business.
business_problem: Freelancers often struggle with inconsistent pricing and unclear service boundaries.

instruction.overview: Define 3 distinct service packages (Basic, Standard, Premium) with specific deliverables and prices.
steps: Identify 3 common tasks in your freelance niche.
Calculate a base hourly rate based on target monthly income.
Define deliverables for three different package tiers.
Assign a price to each tier based on estimated time and value.
deliverables: A spreadsheet showing service tiers, descriptions, and costs.
submission_requirements: Submit an Excel or CSV file.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Check for logical price progression between tiers.

title: Personal Brand Identity for Freelancers
short_description: Design a basic visual brand kit for a freelance business.
business_problem: Without a consistent visual identity, a freelancer's brand looks unprofessional and unorganized.

instruction.overview: Create a one-page brand style guide including a logo, color palette, and font choices.
steps: Create a mood board representing the 'vibe' of your freelance brand.
Design a simple wordmark or icon-based logo.
Select a primary and secondary color (hex codes required).
Choose two professional fonts that complement your brand.
Combine all elements into a single-page brand guide.
deliverables: A single brand style guide image or PDF.
submission_requirements: Submit a PNG or PDF file.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on consistency and readability of the chosen fonts.

title: Designing a Client Onboarding Questionnaire
short_description: Develop a set of questions to gather project requirements from new clients efficiently.
business_problem: Poorly defined project requirements lead to scope creep and wasted time for freelancers.

instruction.overview: You will create a professional intake form that a freelancer would send to a client after they agree to work together.
steps: Define 5 core categories of information needed (e.g., Project Goals, Technical Requirements).
Write 15 targeted questions to extract specific project details.
Organize the questions in a logical flow from broad to specific.
Include a section for client contact details and preferred communication methods.
deliverables: A structured questionnaire document.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Questions should be designed to minimize back-and-forth communication.

title: Freelance Market Analysis for Niche Skills
short_description: Perform research on a specific freelance niche to determine demand and competition.
business_problem: Many freelancers pick skills that are either too saturated or have no market demand.

instruction.overview: Research a specific niche (e.g., 'Shopify SEO' or 'Social Media for Law Firms') and document the landscape.
steps: Identify 5 successful freelancers in the niche on platforms like Fiverr or Upwork.
Compare their pricing, service offerings, and review counts.
Identify one 'market gap' or underserved area within this niche.
Summarize why this niche is or isn't viable for a beginner.
deliverables: A 3-page market research report.
starter_resources: Guide to market research for freelancers
instruction.evaluation_notes: Look for depth in the competitor comparison.

title: Freelance Financial Tracking Spreadsheet
short_description: Create a spreadsheet to track income, platform fees, and business expenses.
business_problem: Freelancers often lose track of net profit after platform fees and software costs.

instruction.overview: Build a functional spreadsheet that automatically calculates net profit after deducting fees and expenses.
steps: Create columns for Date, Client Name, Gross Amount, and Platform Fee %.
Add a section for monthly fixed expenses (subscriptions, internet).
Write formulas to calculate Net Amount per project.
Create a summary dashboard showing total monthly profit and profit margin percentage.
Enter 5 rows of sample data to demonstrate the math.
deliverables: A functional Excel or Google Sheets file.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Formulas must be accurate and handle different fee percentages.

title: Single-Page HTML Portfolio for Freelancers
short_description: Code a basic responsive portfolio page to showcase freelance services.
business_problem: Freelancers need a central hub outside of social media to demonstrate their technical professionalism.

instruction.overview: Develop a simple, clean, and responsive personal portfolio using only HTML and CSS.
steps: Create an 'About' section with your professional bio.
Build a 'Services' section using a grid layout.
Include a 'Contact' section with a form (doesn't need to be functional).
Add CSS media queries to ensure the page looks good on mobile.
Include a README file explaining how to view the page.
deliverables: A ZIP file containing index.html, style.css, and images.
submission_requirements: Code projects must be submitted as one .zip upload only.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Code should be clean and properly indented.

title: Drafting a Standard Freelance Service Agreement
short_description: Create a legally-styled contract template for freelance projects.
business_problem: Freelancers are vulnerable to non-payment or legal disputes without a clear written agreement.

instruction.overview: You will draft a 2-3 page contract template that covers the essential legal protections for a freelancer.
steps: Outline sections for Scope of Work, Payment Schedule, and Deadlines.
Write a clause regarding Intellectual Property (who owns the work?).
Include a 'Termination' clause specifying how either party can end the contract.
Draft a 'Late Payment' clause with specific penalties.
Ensure all legal language is clear and professional.
deliverables: A comprehensive contract template document.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Evaluate the clarity and fairness of the payment terms.

title: Scripted Invoice Generator for Freelance Work
short_description: Write a Python script that generates a text-based or PDF invoice from user input.
business_problem: Manually creating invoices for every project is time-consuming and prone to typos.

instruction.overview: Create a Python tool that asks for client name, service description, and amount, then outputs a formatted invoice file.
steps: Write a script that accepts user input for project details.
Include a function to calculate tax based on a fixed percentage.
Format the output into a clean, readable text file or HTML file.
Generate a unique invoice number using a simple logic (e.g., date-based).
Test the script with 2 different scenarios.
deliverables: A ZIP file containing the .py script and a sample output file.
submission_requirements: Code projects must be submitted as one .zip upload only.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Check for robust input handling and professional output formatting.

title: Weekly Social Media Content Calendar
short_description: Create a 7-day social media plan for a fictional local coffee shop.
business_problem: Small businesses struggle to maintain a consistent online presence without a structured posting schedule.

instruction.overview: You will draft a one-week content calendar including captions, suggested visuals, and posting times.
steps: Define the coffee shop's target audience and brand voice.
Select three content pillars (e.g., behind-the-scenes, product highlights, customer reviews).
Write captions for 7 unique posts (one per day).
Suggest a specific visual or video idea for each post.
Include 5 relevant hashtags for each entry.
deliverables: A 7-day content calendar table.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the variety of content and the relevance of hashtags.

title: Keyword Research for a Local Service Business
short_description: Identify high-potential keywords for a local plumbing company to improve search visibility.
business_problem: Local businesses often bid on keywords that are too broad, wasting budget and missing local leads.

instruction.overview: Research and list 20 keywords divided by user intent (Informational vs. Transactional).
steps: Brainstorm 5 core services for a plumbing business.
Use a free tool (like Google Keyword Planner or Ubersuggest) to find related terms.
Identify 10 high-intent keywords (e.g., 'emergency plumber near me').
Identify 10 informational keywords (e.g., 'how to fix a leaky faucet').
Include estimated monthly search volume for each.
deliverables: A spreadsheet with 20 keywords, intent classification, and volume.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Keywords should be specific to the 'local' nature of the business.

title: Google Search Ad Copywriting
short_description: Draft high-converting text ads for a new fitness app launch.
business_problem: Ad campaigns fail when headlines are not compelling enough to earn a click from the target audience.

instruction.overview: Write three variations of a Google Search Ad (Responsive Search Ad format) for a mobile fitness app.
steps: Identify the top 3 benefits of the fitness app.
Write 5 unique headlines (max 30 characters each).
Write 2 unique description lines (max 90 characters each).
Incorporate a clear 'Call to Action' (CTA) in every ad variation.
Ensure the copy uses 'you' oriented language to speak to the user.
deliverables: A document containing the headlines and descriptions.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Strictly check character counts; exceeding limits is a fail.

title: Influencer Outreach Discovery List
short_description: Find and vet 10 micro-influencers for a sustainable skincare brand.
business_problem: Brands often pick influencers based on follower count only, resulting in low engagement and poor ROI.

instruction.overview: Create a list of 10 potential influencers on Instagram or TikTok with followers between 5k and 50k.
steps: Identify the 'sustainable skincare' niche requirements.
Search for influencers using relevant hashtags.
Calculate the engagement rate for each (Likes + Comments / Followers).
List their handle, follower count, and primary content style.
Provide a brief reason why each influencer fits the brand.
deliverables: A spreadsheet with the vetted list of 10 influencers.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Prioritize influencers with high engagement over high follower counts.

title: On-Page SEO Blog Optimization Report
short_description: Review and optimize a blog post for better search engine rankings.
business_problem: Great content often fails to rank because it lacks technical SEO elements like proper headers and meta tags.

instruction.overview: Take a 500-word unoptimized blog post (provided or self-written) and provide an optimization plan.
steps: Identify a primary and secondary keyword for the post.
Rewrite the Title Tag and Meta Description for SEO.
Structure the content using H1, H2, and H3 tags correctly.
Suggest 'Alt Text' for 2 images within the post.
Recommend two internal links and one authoritative external link.
deliverables: An SEO audit/optimization report in PDF format.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The Meta description must be within 150-160 characters.

title: Email Welcome Sequence Workflow
short_description: Map out a 3-part email automation sequence for new subscribers.
business_problem: Businesses lose leads when they don't engage new subscribers immediately with a welcome sequence.

instruction.overview: Design a flowchart and write the copy for a 3-email 'Welcome' series for an e-commerce brand.
steps: Define the trigger (e.g., user signs up for a 10% discount).
Map the flow: Email 1 (Instant), Email 2 (Day 2), Email 3 (Day 5).
Draft subject lines and 100-word body copy for each email.
Include a logical 'split' (e.g., if user buys in Email 1, stop the sequence).
Use a tool like Lucidchart, Canva, or a clear drawing for the flow.
deliverables: One design file/image showing the flow and the email copy.
submission_requirements: Submit a PNG or PDF file.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The logic of the flow must be easy to follow.

title: Facebook Ads Budget and Audience Planner
short_description: Create a structured media plan for a $1,000 monthly ad spend.
business_problem: Inexperienced marketers often spend money without a clear plan for audience targeting or budget allocation.

instruction.overview: Build a spreadsheet that plans out a Facebook Ads campaign for a local gym.
steps: Split a $1,000 budget into 3 campaigns: Awareness, Consideration, and Conversion.
Define specific interests and demographics for the 'Awareness' audience.
Set daily budgets and duration for each campaign.
Include a 'Estimated Results' column based on industry benchmarks.
Describe the visual/creative direction for each campaign.
deliverables: A spreadsheet media plan.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Check if the budget allocation aligns with the campaign goals.

title: Marketing Performance Dashboard Mockup
short_description: Build a data visualization dashboard to report on monthly marketing KPIs.
business_problem: Clients and managers need a high-level view of performance without digging through raw data.

instruction.overview: Use sample data to create a visual dashboard in a spreadsheet showing trends in traffic, leads, and sales.
steps: Create a 'Raw Data' tab with 6 months of dummy data (Clicks, Impressions, Spend, Leads).
Create a 'Calculated' tab for formulas (CTR, CPC, Conversion Rate).
Build a 'Dashboard' tab using charts (Line, Bar, Pie) to visualize the data.
Add a summary section explaining the month-over-month (MoM) growth.
Ensure the dashboard is 'client-ready' with clear labels and colors.
deliverables: An Excel file with a functional visual dashboard.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Formulas must be dynamic and charts should clearly show trends.

title: Content Strategy and Promotion Roadmap
short_description: Develop a comprehensive 3-month strategy for a B2B SaaS startup.
business_problem: B2B companies often create content without a plan for distribution, leading to low reach and engagement.

instruction.overview: Create a 5-page strategic roadmap covering content creation, distribution channels, and growth goals.
steps: Conduct a SWOT analysis for the startup's current digital presence.
Define 3 primary 'Content Offers' (e.g., E-book, Webinar, Case Study).
Map out a multi-channel distribution plan (LinkedIn, Email, SEO).
Set specific SMART goals for the next 90 days.
Define the resources and tools required for execution.
deliverables: A 5-page strategic PDF document.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Strategy should show a clear link between content and business goals.

title: Python SEO Meta-Tag Validator
short_description: Write a script to check if a webpage has the required SEO meta tags.
business_problem: Checking SEO tags manually for hundreds of pages is impossible; automation is needed for efficiency.

instruction.overview: Create a Python script that takes a URL as input and checks for Title, Meta Description, and H1 tags.
steps: Set up a Python environment with the 'requests' and 'BeautifulSoup' libraries.
Write a function to fetch the HTML content of a given URL.
Extract the <title>, <meta name='description'>, and all <h1> tags.
Return a 'PASS' or 'FAIL' report based on whether these tags exist and meet length requirements.
Add a README explaining how to run the script.
deliverables: A ZIP file containing the .py script and README.
submission_requirements: Code projects must be submitted as one .zip upload only.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The script should handle errors gracefully (e.g., if a site blocks scraping).

title: Optimizing Product Listings for Search
short_description: Rewrite product titles and descriptions to improve visibility on an e-commerce platform.
business_problem: Poorly written product descriptions lead to low click-through rates and high bounce rates on store pages.

instruction.overview: You will take three poorly formatted product listings and rewrite them using SEO best practices and persuasive copy.
steps: Select three generic product descriptions (e.g., a water bottle, a desk lamp, a yoga mat).
Perform a quick keyword search for what buyers look for in these items.
Rewrite the product titles to be descriptive and keyword-rich (max 150 characters).
Draft 5 bullet points for each product focusing on benefits rather than just features.
Write a 150-word product description for each that includes a call to action.
deliverables: A document containing the 'Before' and 'After' for three product listings.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Look for a clear improvement in clarity and keyword usage between the before and after versions.

title: Market Pricing Research for New Products
short_description: Analyze competitor prices to recommend a competitive price point for a new store item.
business_problem: Pricing products too high leads to no sales, while pricing too low hurts profit margins and brand perception.

instruction.overview: Conduct a pricing audit for a specific electronic gadget across three major e-commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon, eBay, Walmart).
steps: Select one specific electronic product (e.g., 'Noise Canceling Headphones').
Find the price of this product from 5 different sellers on different platforms.
Calculate the average market price and identify the highest and lowest points.
Propose a final selling price for your own store.
Provide a 2-sentence justification for your chosen price based on the data.
deliverables: A spreadsheet with the pricing comparison and final recommendation.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Data accuracy is more important than the specific product chosen.

title: Customer Feedback Categorization
short_description: Review and categorize customer reviews to identify top product improvement areas.
business_problem: Business owners often ignore customer reviews or fail to spot patterns that indicate product defects.

instruction.overview: Analyze 20 provided (or found) customer reviews for a single product and group them by theme.
steps: Find a product with at least 20 reviews (mixture of positive and negative).
Create categories for the feedback (e.g., Shipping, Product Quality, Packaging).
Assign each review to a category and label the sentiment (Positive, Negative, Neutral).
Summarize the top 3 issues customers are facing.
Suggest one simple action the business could take to resolve each issue.
deliverables: A document showing the categorization and a summary of findings.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the logic used to group the reviews.

title: Simple Stock Level Tracker
short_description: Design a basic spreadsheet to track inventory levels and signal when to restock.
business_problem: Small e-commerce stores often run out of stock because they don't track their inventory regularly.

instruction.overview: Create a spreadsheet that tracks 10 items with automated status updates when stock gets low.
steps: Create columns for SKU, Product Name, Current Stock, and Reorder Point (minimum level).
Enter data for 10 sample products.
Write a simple 'IF' formula to display 'Restock' if Current Stock is below Reorder Point.
Use conditional formatting to highlight rows that need restocking in red.
Add a column for 'Last Restocked Date'.
deliverables: A spreadsheet with 10 products and functional formulas.
submission_requirements: Submit an Excel or Google Sheets file (.xlsx).
instruction.evaluation_notes: Check that the formula correctly triggers the restock alert.

title: High-Conversion Product Page Mockup
short_description: Design a wireframe for a product page optimized for mobile shopping.
business_problem: Mobile users have low attention spans; if a product page is cluttered, they will leave without buying.

instruction.overview: Create a visual mockup of a mobile product page that places the most important information first.
steps: Define the 5 most critical elements of a product page (e.g., price, image, rating).
Design a mobile-view layout showing where these elements are placed.
Ensure the 'Add to Cart' button is visible without scrolling ('above the fold').
Include sections for 'Related Products' and 'Customer Reviews'.
Add short annotations explaining why you placed elements in those specific spots.
deliverables: One image file or PDF showing the mobile mockup and annotations.
submission_requirements: Submit as a PNG, JPG, or PDF.
starter_resources: Mobile UX best practices for e-commerce
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the logical placement of the CTA (Call to Action).

title: E-commerce Operations & Refund Policy
short_description: Draft a professional shipping and refund policy for an online store.
business_problem: Vague return policies lead to customer disputes and financial loss for the business.

instruction.overview: Create a clear, customer-friendly Shipping and Refund policy for a new clothing brand.
steps: Define the timeframe for returns (e.g., 30 days).
Specify the condition items must be in to qualify for a refund.
Explain who pays for return shipping (business or customer).
Draft a section on shipping times and how customers can track orders.
Write a 'Frequently Asked Questions' (FAQ) section with 5 common queries.
deliverables: A 2-page document containing the policy and FAQ.
starter_resources: How to write a return policy
instruction.evaluation_notes: Policy must be clear enough for a teenager to understand.

title: Automated Abandoned Cart Email Flow
short_description: Map out a 2-email sequence to recover customers who left items in their cart.
business_problem: Nearly 70% of online shoppers abandon their carts; without automation, that revenue is lost forever.

instruction.overview: Design a flowchart and write the copy for two emails sent after a user abandons their cart.
steps: Define the trigger and wait time for Email 1 (e.g., 1 hour after abandonment).
Write a catchy subject line and body copy for Email 1 (The 'Gentle Reminder').
Set a wait time for Email 2 (e.g., 24 hours later).
Write the copy for Email 2, including a discount code to incentivize the purchase.
Create a simple diagram showing the flow using any design tool.
deliverables: One file showing the flowchart and the text for both emails.
submission_requirements: Submit a single PNG or PDF.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Evaluate the strength of the subject lines and the logical flow.

title: E-commerce Monthly Sales Analytics Dashboard
short_description: Build a data dashboard to analyze sales trends and profitability.
business_problem: Store owners need to know which products are profitable and which are costing money in ads/fees.

instruction.overview: Use sample sales data to create a visual dashboard that calculates key e-commerce metrics.
steps: Create a 'Sales' sheet with 50 rows of raw data (Order ID, Product, Price, Cost, Marketing Spend).
Use formulas to calculate 'Gross Profit' and 'Net Profit' for each order.
Create a Pivot Table to summarize total sales by Product Category.
Build a Dashboard sheet with 3 charts: Sales over Time, Profit by Product, and Marketing Spend vs. Revenue.
Write a 100-word summary of the store's performance based on the charts.
deliverables: An Excel file with a functional dashboard and summary.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Formulas must be accurate and charts should be easy to read.

title: Shipping Cost Automation Script
short_description: Write a Python script that calculates shipping fees based on weight and destination.
business_problem: Manual shipping calculation for international orders is slow and leads to errors in customer billing.

instruction.overview: Develop a script that takes a package weight and country as input and returns the shipping cost.
steps: Define 3 shipping zones (Local, Regional, International) with different base prices.
Add a weight-based surcharge (e.g., $2 per kg).
Write a function that calculates the total cost based on user input.
Include error handling for negative weights or unsupported countries.
Print a clean receipt-style output for the user.
deliverables: A ZIP file containing the Python script and a README.
submission_requirements: Code projects must be submitted as one .zip upload only.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The script should be bug-free and handle edge cases like '0 kg' or 'Unknown Country'.

title: Comprehensive E-commerce UX/SEO Audit
short_description: Analyze an existing online store and suggest improvements for speed and user experience.
business_problem: Slow websites and confusing navigation kill conversions even if the products are great.

instruction.overview: Pick a real (or provided) small e-commerce site and conduct a thorough audit of its user experience and technical SEO.
steps: Use a tool like Google PageSpeed Insights to check the site's performance.
Analyze the checkout process and list any 'friction points' (e.g., too many forms).
Evaluate the site's mobile friendliness.
Check for SEO basics like missing alt text or poor header structure.
Compile findings into a professional report with screenshots and 10 actionable recommendations.
deliverables: A 5-page audit report in PDF format.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the quality of the recommendations; they must be practical and specific.

title: Minimalist Logo for a Tech Startup
short_description: Design a clean, modern logo for a fictional software company named 'Nexus'.
business_problem: New companies often lack a visual identity, making it difficult for customers to recognize and trust their brand.

instruction.overview: Create a simple vector logo that represents connectivity and innovation.
steps: Sketch 3 rough concepts for a 'Nexus' logo on paper or digitally.
Choose the best concept and recreate it using a vector tool (Canva, Figma, or Illustrator).
Apply a professional two-color palette.
Ensure the logo is readable at both large and small sizes.
Export the final design in high resolution.
deliverables: A single PNG or PDF showing the logo in color and in black and white.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on simplicity and how well the icon represents the name 'Nexus'.

title: Instagram Carousel for Educational Content
short_description: Design a 5-slide Instagram carousel that teaches a simple 'How-to' topic.
business_problem: Brands need engaging social media content that keeps users sliding and improves platform reach.

instruction.overview: Create a visually consistent 5-slide set for Instagram on a topic like '3 Tips for Better Sleep' or 'How to Brew Coffee'.
steps: Select a simple educational topic.
Design a cover slide with a bold headline and eye-catching image.
Create 3 informational slides with consistent fonts and colors.
Design the final slide with a 'Call to Action' (e.g., 'Save this post').
Ensure visual elements 'connect' between slides to encourage swiping.
deliverables: A single PDF containing all 5 slides.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The transition between slides should feel seamless and intentional.

title: Modern Business Card Design
short_description: Create a double-sided business card for a freelance photographer.
business_problem: Physical networking still requires professional-looking cards that stand out in a stack.

instruction.overview: Design a standard 3.5x2 inch business card that balances visual impact with readable contact info.
steps: Set up a document with standard print dimensions (3.5x2 inches) plus bleed.
Place a high-quality placeholder photo on the front side.
Layout the name, title, and contact details on the back side.
Use a hierarchy that makes the name the most prominent element.
Choose a font pairing that looks professional and clean.
deliverables: A PDF showing both the front and back of the card.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Ensure text is not too close to the edges (safety margins).

title: Brand Mood Board and Color Palette
short_description: Develop a visual mood board and color scheme for an organic tea brand.
business_problem: Before designing assets, a brand needs a defined 'look and feel' to ensure all future designs are consistent.

instruction.overview: Gather images, textures, and colors to define the aesthetic of 'EarthLeaf Tea'.
steps: Collect 5-8 images that represent 'organic', 'calm', and 'natural'.
Arrange images into a balanced collage.
Select 5 colors from the images to create a brand palette.
List the Hex codes for each of the 5 colors.
Briefly describe why this aesthetic fits an organic tea brand.
deliverables: A single-page design/PDF containing the mood board and color palette.
submission_requirements: Submit as a PNG or PDF.
starter_resources: How to create a mood board
instruction.evaluation_notes: The colors should feel harmonious and appropriate for the industry.

title: Event Flyer and Promotion Kit
short_description: Design a high-impact flyer for a local music festival.
business_problem: Events need to grab attention quickly in public spaces and online to drive ticket sales.

instruction.overview: Design an A4 flyer for 'Summer Beats 2026' that includes specific event details and a clear headliner.
steps: Set up an A4 canvas with appropriate print margins.
Create a background using a combination of image and color overlays.
Layout the festival name, date, location, and list of artists.
Ensure the 'Call to Action' (e.g., website URL) is extremely clear.
Use typography that matches the high-energy vibe of a music festival.
deliverables: One A4 flyer design in PDF format.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The most important information (Who, Where, When) must be readable from a distance.

title: Data-Driven Healthcare Infographic
short_description: Convert complex health statistics into a simple, easy-to-read vertical infographic.
business_problem: Public health data is often boring and hard to understand; infographics make it digestible for the general public.

instruction.overview: Visualize 5 key facts about 'The Benefits of Daily Walking' using icons and minimal text.
steps: Research 5 specific statistics or facts about walking and health.
Design a vertical layout that leads the eye from top to bottom.
Use unique icons or illustrations for each of the 5 points.
Include a simple chart or graph representing one of the data points.
Keep the text to a minimum, focusing on the visual representation.
deliverables: A high-resolution vertical infographic (PNG or PDF).
instruction.evaluation_notes: The data must be presented accurately and the icons should clearly represent the text.

title: Responsive Homepage Layout Mockup
short_description: Design the visual layout for a bakery's homepage for both desktop and mobile.
business_problem: Websites must look great on all devices to ensure customers can order products easily from their phones.

instruction.overview: Create a visual mockup (not code) for a bakery's homepage that displays the same content optimized for two screen sizes.
steps: Design a desktop version showing a hero image, navigation bar, and featured products.
Design a mobile version showing how those same elements stack vertically.
Ensure the brand colors and fonts are consistent across both views.
Use a clear, clickable-looking 'Order Now' button in both designs.
Add short notes on how the menu changes for mobile (e.g., 'hamburger menu').
deliverables: One image or PDF containing both the desktop and mobile mockups side-by-side.
submission_requirements: Submit as a single PNG or PDF.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the logical reorganization of content for the smaller screen.

title: Full Brand Identity Guidelines
short_description: Create a comprehensive document that defines how a brand should be presented visually.
business_problem: As companies grow, different designers may work on the brand; guidelines ensure everything looks like it belongs to the same company.

instruction.overview: Develop a 6-8 page 'Brand Bible' for a fictional gym called 'Apex Fitness'.
steps: Design the primary logo and a simplified icon version.
Create a 'Logo Usage' page showing correct and incorrect ways to use the logo.
Define the official color palette with HEX, RGB, and CMYK values.
Specify primary and secondary typefaces and how they should be used (Headings vs Body).
Include a page showing the brand's 'Visual Style' using example photography.
Draft a short section on the brand's 'Tone of Voice'.
deliverables: A multi-page brand guidelines PDF.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Evaluate based on the clarity of the rules and the professional presentation of the document.

title: Eco-Friendly Product Packaging Mockup
short_description: Design and visualize the packaging for a sustainable soap brand.
business_problem: Packaging is the first physical touchpoint for a customer; it must communicate the brand's values immediately.

instruction.overview: Design the flat 'dieline' (layout) for a soap box and place it on a 3D mockup.
steps: Create a flat layout for a soap box (Front, Back, Sides, Flaps).
Include the logo, product name, weight, and a list of ingredients.
Design a pattern or illustration that wraps around the sides of the box.
Apply the flat design onto a 3D box mockup image.
Ensure all legal text (ingredients) is legible but doesn't distract from the design.
deliverables: A PDF showing both the flat dieline and the finished 3D mockup.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Check for consistency between the flat design and the 3D visualization.

title: Mobile App Dashboard UI Components
short_description: Design a set of reusable UI components for a fitness tracking application.
business_problem: App developers need a set of consistent buttons, cards, and icons before they can begin coding a new interface.

instruction.overview: Create a UI component library for a fitness app, focusing on reusable elements for a dashboard.
steps: Design 3 primary button styles (Default, Hover, Disabled).
Create a 'Stats Card' component that shows heart rate or steps.
Design 5 custom line-style icons for the navigation bar (e.g., Home, Profile, Activity).
Develop a color and typography system for the components.
Organize all components onto a single 'Style Sheet' or design board.
deliverables: A single-page design/PDF showing all UI components organized by category.
submission_requirements: Submit as a PNG or PDF.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the consistency of the 'corners' (border-radius) and spacing across all components.

title: Long-Tail Keyword Discovery for Travel Blogs
short_description: Identify specific, low-competition keywords to help a travel blog rank faster.
business_problem: New blogs cannot compete for broad terms like 'travel' and need specific 'long-tail' phrases to attract traffic.

instruction.overview: Research and find 15 long-tail keywords for a travel blog focusing on 'Budget Travel in Southeast Asia'.
steps: Brainstorm 3 broad topics related to budget travel in Southeast Asia.
Use a free keyword tool to find 5 long-tail variations (3+ words) for each topic.
Record the estimated monthly search volume for each keyword.
Label each keyword as 'Informational' or 'Transactional' based on user intent.
Highlight the top 3 keywords you would recommend for a new blogger.
deliverables: A spreadsheet containing 15 keywords with volume and intent labels.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Ensure keywords are specific and not overly competitive.

title: High-CTR Meta Tags for Fashion Stores
short_description: Write SEO-optimized titles and descriptions for a local clothing boutique's top pages.
business_problem: Even if a site ranks well, poor meta tags result in fewer clicks from the search results page.

instruction.overview: Create optimized meta tags for the Homepage, Summer Collection page, and About Us page of a boutique.
steps: Define the primary keyword for each of the three pages.
Write a Title Tag for each page (max 60 characters).
Draft a Meta Description for each page (max 155 characters).
Ensure each description includes a clear 'Call to Action' like 'Shop Now' or 'Visit Us'.
Explain in one sentence why these tags will improve click-through rates.
deliverables: A document with optimized tags for three pages.
starter_resources: Title tag and meta description length checker
instruction.evaluation_notes: Character limits must be strictly followed to prevent cutting off in search results.

title: SEO-Friendly URL Mapping for Personal Sites
short_description: Restructure confusing website URLs into clean, search-friendly paths.
business_problem: Messy URLs with random numbers and symbols make it hard for search engines and users to understand page content.

instruction.overview: Rewrite a list of 10 'messy' URLs into optimized, SEO-friendly versions.
steps: Review a provided list of 10 unoptimized URLs (e.g., [example.com/p=123?cat=4](https://example.com/p=123?cat=4)).
Assign a logical name to each page based on its context.
Rewrite each URL using only lowercase letters, hyphens, and keywords.
Ensure the structure shows clear site hierarchy (e.g., /category/product-name).
Write a brief rulebook (3-5 points) for maintaining clean URLs.
deliverables: A table showing old URLs vs. new optimized URLs and the rulebook.
instruction.evaluation_notes: No underscores, spaces, or special characters should remain in the new URLs.

title: Competitor Keyword Gap Analysis Report
short_description: Identify keywords that competitors are ranking for but your site is missing.
business_problem: Businesses often miss out on high-traffic opportunities because they don't know what their competitors are targeting.

instruction.overview: Compare two similar websites and find 10 keywords that one site ranks for and the other does not.
steps: Select two competing local businesses (e.g., two bakeries in the same city).
Find 5 keywords each business ranks for using search results or SEO tools.
Identify 10 total 'gaps' (keywords Site A has but Site B lacks).
Summarize which site is winning the 'SEO battle' and why.
Provide 3 suggestions for how the losing site can start ranking for those gaps.
deliverables: A 2-3 page PDF report summarizing the findings.
starter_resources: Free tools for competitor keyword research
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the relevance of the keywords to the local business.

title: Content Optimization and Heading Structure Plan
short_description: Audit and restructure a blog post to improve its readability and SEO signals.
business_problem: Thin or poorly structured content fails to rank because search engines can't determine the topic hierarchy.

instruction.overview: Take a 500-word unoptimized article and rewrite its structure for better SEO performance.
steps: Select an article with poor formatting or a provided sample text.
Identify the primary focus keyword and 3 secondary (semantic) keywords.
Reorganize the text using one H1, multiple H2s, and sub-H3 tags.
Incorporate keywords naturally into the headers and first 100 words.
Add a summary of readability improvements (sentence length, transition words).
deliverables: A Word document showing the 'New' structure and a list of used keywords.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Keywords must not feel forced or overused (avoid keyword stuffing).

title: Technical SEO Site Speed and Error Audit
short_description: Test a website's technical health and identify speed bottlenecks and crawl errors.
business_problem: Slow loading times and 404 errors frustrate users and cause search engines to lower a site's ranking.

instruction.overview: Conduct a technical audit on a small website (e.g., a local non-profit) and log critical errors.
steps: Run the website through Google PageSpeed Insights for both Mobile and Desktop.
Record the Core Web Vitals scores (LCP, FID, CLS).
Identify 3 specific images or scripts that are slowing the site down.
Manually check for 5 broken links (404 errors) or missing alt tags on images.
Create an action plan in the spreadsheet to fix the top 3 technical issues.
deliverables: A spreadsheet with audit data, scores, and an improvement plan.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Recommendations must be technical (e.g., 'compress images' not just 'fix speed').

title: Visual Internal Linking Architecture Map
short_description: Design a linking map to pass authority from high-performing pages to new content.
business_problem: Isolated pages (orphan pages) don't rank well because they aren't linked to from other parts of the site.

instruction.overview: Create a visual map showing how 10 pages on a website should link to each other to boost SEO.
steps: Define one 'Pillar Page' (the main topic) and 5 'Cluster Pages' (sub-topics).
Draw a flowchart showing links from clusters back to the pillar.
Include specific 'Anchor Text' recommendations for 5 key links.
Show how the Homepage links to the Pillar Page to pass authority.
Add a 200-word explanation of why this 'Silo' structure helps SEO.
deliverables: An image or PDF diagram showing the linking structure and anchor text.
submission_requirements: Submit a PNG, JPG, or PDF file.
starter_resources: Topic clusters and pillar pages guide
instruction.evaluation_notes: The map should clearly show a logical flow of link authority.

title: Schema Markup Implementation Guide
short_description: Create a structured data plan to help search engines display 'Rich Snippets'.
business_problem: Search engines need code-level context (Schema) to show star ratings, prices, or event dates in results.

instruction.overview: Develop a JSON-LD Schema plan for three different page types: a Product, an FAQ, and an Article.
steps: Research the required fields for 'Product' and 'FAQ' schema on Schema.org.
Write a sample JSON-LD code block for a fictional product (including price and reviews).
Write a JSON-LD block for an FAQ page with 3 questions and answers.
Explain how this code should be placed on a live website (header vs body).
Describe how Schema affects the visual look of search results.
deliverables: A 4-page PDF guide including the code blocks and implementation steps.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Code syntax must be correct JSON format.

title: Comprehensive SEO Strategy and Migration Checklist
short_description: Develop a high-level roadmap for launching a new site or moving to a new domain.
business_problem: Website migrations often cause massive traffic drops if SEO steps (like redirects) are forgotten.

instruction.overview: Build a master checklist of 30+ SEO tasks divided into Pre-Launch, Launch, and Post-Launch phases.
steps: Identify 10 technical tasks (e.g., set up Search Console, robots.txt).
Identify 10 on-page tasks (e.g., keyword mapping, meta tag audit).
Identify 10 post-launch tasks (e.g., monitoring crawl errors, backlink checking).
Assign a 'Priority' and 'Owner' to each task in the spreadsheet.
Include a 'Redirect Map' tab showing how 5 old URLs move to new ones.
deliverables: A detailed multi-tab spreadsheet checklist.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Prioritization should be logical (e.g., technical setup before content audit).

title: Python SEO Keyword Frequency Tool
short_description: Build a script to analyze a block of text and report on keyword density and counts.
business_problem: Content editors need to quickly check if a writer has used the target keywords too much or too little.

instruction.overview: Create a Python script that takes a .txt file as input and outputs a list of the top 10 most used words.
steps: Write code to open and read a text file.
Clean the text by removing punctuation and converting to lowercase.
Count the occurrence of every word and store it in a dictionary.
Calculate the 'density' percentage of a specific target keyword provided by the user.
Print a summary table of the top 10 words and their counts.
Include a README explaining how to run the script.
deliverables: A ZIP file containing the .py script, a sample .txt file, and a README.
submission_requirements: Code projects must be submitted as one .zip upload only.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The script must handle common punctuation and ignore case sensitivity.

title: WordPress Site Architecture Blueprint
short_description: Plan the page structure and navigation for a professional portfolio website.
business_problem: Without a clear sitemap, WordPress sites often become cluttered, making it difficult for users to find essential information.

instruction.overview: You will design a sitemap and navigation plan for a freelancer's WordPress site.
steps: Define 5 core pages necessary for a professional portfolio.
Create a visual or text-based hierarchy showing parent and child pages.
Plan the primary navigation menu labels.
Assign specific WordPress 'Categories' and 'Tags' for a blog section.
Identify which page will be set as the 'Static Homepage'.
deliverables: A document detailing the sitemap and menu structure.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the logical flow of the menu from a user's perspective.

title: WordPress Content Audit and URL Map
short_description: Audit existing content and plan a clean URL structure for a blog migration.
business_problem: Migrating content without a URL plan leads to broken links and a significant drop in search engine rankings.

instruction.overview: Create a spreadsheet to inventory 10 blog posts and define their optimized WordPress permalink slugs.
steps: List 10 hypothetical blog titles for a niche of your choice.
Assign a 'Current URL' (unoptimized) to each post.
Draft a 'New Slug' for each using WordPress SEO best practices (lowercase, hyphens).
Categorize each post (e.g., News, Tutorial, Review).
Mark the status of each (e.g., Published, Draft, Trash).
deliverables: A spreadsheet containing the content audit and URL map.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Slugs must be concise and avoid 'stop words' like 'and' or 'the'.

title: WordPress Plugin Security and Performance Audit
short_description: Review a list of plugins to determine their impact on site health.
business_problem: Installing too many or outdated plugins can slow down a site and create security vulnerabilities.

instruction.overview: Analyze 5 popular WordPress plugins and document their pros, cons, and potential risks.
steps: Select 5 plugins from the official WordPress.org repository.
Check the 'Last Updated' date and 'Active Installations' for each.
Identify if any have known security vulnerabilities using public databases.
Note the file size or 'bloat' level for each plugin.
Recommend a 'Lite' or more efficient alternative for at least one plugin.
deliverables: A 2-page plugin audit report.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Evaluation is based on the depth of the research for each plugin.

title: Theme Customizer Visual Palette
short_description: Define the visual settings for a WordPress theme to match a corporate brand.
business_problem: Inconsistent colors and fonts across a WordPress site make a business look unprofessional.

instruction.overview: Create a design guide that dictates the Global Styles settings for a WordPress site.
steps: Select a primary, secondary, and accent color (Hex codes).
Choose a font pair (one for Headings, one for Body) available in Google Fonts.
Design the visual style for a 'Primary Button' (color, padding, border-radius).
Define the background color for the Header and Footer.
Create a one-page visual guide showing these elements together.
deliverables: A one-page design document or PDF visual guide.
submission_requirements: Submit a PNG or PDF file.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Consistency and accessibility (contrast) are key.

title: Gutenberg Block-Based Landing Page Wireframe
short_description: Sketch the layout of a landing page using native WordPress blocks.
business_problem: Developers and clients need a visual layout plan before starting the build to avoid costly revisions.

instruction.overview: Design a wireframe for a high-converting landing page using only standard Gutenberg blocks.
steps: Identify the 'Hero' section components (Heading, Paragraph, Button).
Plan a 3-column 'Features' section using 'Column' blocks.
Include a 'Testimonial' section with an image and text block.
Add a 'Call to Action' section at the bottom of the page.
Label each section with the specific Gutenberg block name to be used.
deliverables: A landing page wireframe with block annotations.
submission_requirements: Submit as a single PDF or PNG.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The wireframe must be practical to build with native WordPress blocks.

title: Basic WordPress Child Theme Styling
short_description: Create a child theme and apply custom CSS to modify a parent theme's appearance.
business_problem: Modifying parent theme files directly is risky, as all changes are lost during a theme update.

instruction.overview: Set up a standard WordPress child theme folder with a style.css and functions.php file.
steps: Create a folder named 'twentytwentyfour-child' (or similar).
Write the style.css header with the correct 'Template' tag.
Write a functions.php script to properly enqueue the parent and child styles.
Add custom CSS to change the site's main heading color and font size.
Include a README file explaining how to install it.
deliverables: A ZIP file containing the child theme folder and code.
submission_requirements: Code projects must be submitted as one .zip upload only.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The style enqueuing must follow the official WordPress developer standards.

title: WordPress Site Hardening and Backup Strategy
short_description: Develop a comprehensive plan to secure and maintain a WordPress site.
business_problem: WordPress is a frequent target for hackers; without a maintenance plan, sites are prone to downtime and data loss.

instruction.overview: Create a monthly maintenance checklist and security hardening guide for a small business site.
steps: List 5 essential security settings (e.g., changing default admin username).
Recommend a specific backup schedule and storage location (Off-site vs. On-site).
Define a process for safely updating plugins and themes.
Include a section on user role management (who gets what permissions).
Describe a 3-step 'Emergency Plan' for if the site is hacked.
deliverables: A 3-page maintenance and security document.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The backup strategy must prioritize data redundancy.

title: Custom Post Type Registration Snippet
short_description: Write a PHP function to register a 'Books' or 'Portfolio' custom post type.
business_problem: Standard 'Posts' and 'Pages' are insufficient for sites that need to manage specific data like products, reviews, or team members.

instruction.overview: Develop a PHP code snippet to add a new content type to the WordPress admin sidebar.
steps: Define a function that uses the 'register_post_type' WordPress function.
Include custom labels for 'Add New', 'Edit', and 'Search' for the CPT.
Set the post type to support 'thumbnail', 'title', and 'editor'.
Hook the function into the 'init' action.
Provide a README explaining where to paste this code (functions.php vs. plugin).
deliverables: A ZIP file containing the PHP file and a README.
submission_requirements: Code projects must be submitted as one .zip upload only.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The code must follow PHP syntax rules and include proper naming conventions for functions.

title: WooCommerce Bulk Product Management Logic
short_description: Map and prepare a complex CSV file for bulk importing products into WooCommerce.
business_problem: Manually adding hundreds of products to an e-commerce store is impossible; structured bulk imports are required.

instruction.overview: Prepare a 20-row CSV file containing varied product data, including attributes like 'Size' and 'Color'.
steps: Define the mandatory WooCommerce CSV columns (Title, SKU, Price, etc.).
Include 5 'Simple' products and 15 'Variable' product variations.
Assign unique SKUs and correct parent/child relationships in the data.
Include tax classes and stock quantities for every item.
Write a 1-page guide on how to handle 'Image URL' mapping during import.
deliverables: An Excel/CSV file and a PDF instruction guide.
submission_requirements: Submit one .xlsx file and one .pdf file.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Check for correct mapping of variable product parent SKUs.

title: WordPress Site Speed Optimization Audit
short_description: Analyze a slow site and provide a technical optimization report with script recommendations.
business_problem: Slow WordPress sites lose visitors and rank lower on Google; optimization requires technical intervention.

instruction.overview: Create a PHP script to 'deregister' unnecessary scripts on certain pages and write an optimization report.
steps: Write a PHP function to detect a specific page ID and deregister a specific plugin script (e.g., Contact Form 7) from loading there.
Research and list 3 methods for reducing 'Time to First Byte' (TTFB) in WordPress.
Provide a list of recommended settings for a caching plugin.
Explain the benefit of 'WebP' image conversion and how to automate it.
Include a README file for the script portion.
deliverables: A ZIP file containing the PHP optimization script and a PDF audit report.
submission_requirements: Code projects must be submitted as one .zip upload only.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The PHP script must use conditional tags correctly to avoid breaking the site.

title: Email Management and Inbox Organization Plan
short_description: Create a system for organizing a cluttered executive inbox and drafting professional responses.
business_problem: Executives often spend hours sorting through spam and low-priority emails, missing important client communications.

instruction.overview: Develop an organization system and five reusable email templates for common executive requests.
steps: Create a list of 5 email categories (e.g., Urgent, Follow-up, Reading) with color-coding rules.
Write a step-by-step guide on how to filter newsletter spam from a main inbox.
Draft 5 professional email templates for meeting requests, document approvals, and declined invitations.
Outline a 'Daily Inbox Routine' for checking and clearing messages in 30 minutes.
deliverables: A document containing the inbox rules, filters, and 5 email templates.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Templates should be polite, concise, and free of grammatical errors.

title: International Business Travel Itinerary Planning
short_description: Design a detailed 3-day business trip itinerary including flights, accommodation, and meetings.
business_problem: Poorly planned business trips lead to missed meetings and unnecessary stress for travelers.

instruction.overview: You will plan a hypothetical trip for an executive traveling from New York to London for a 3-day conference.
steps: Research and select two flight options (direct and connecting) with pricing.
Find a hotel located within 15 minutes of the conference center.
Create a 3-day schedule including flight times, check-ins, and three lunch meetings.
Calculate the time-zone difference and add a 'rest' period to avoid jet lag.
List the required documents (e.g., Passport, Visa info, Insurance).
deliverables: A 3-day travel itinerary document.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Check for logical timing between flights and hotel check-ins.

title: Weekly Calendar Coordination and Scheduling
short_description: Manage a complex weekly schedule with multiple stakeholders and time zones.
business_problem: Managers often face double-bookings when working with teams across different continents.

instruction.overview: Set up a weekly calendar for a manager coordinating with teams in GMT, EST, and IST.
steps: Map out a 'workday' window that overlaps at least 2 hours for all three time zones.
Schedule 5 recurring meetings while avoiding existing blocked times.
Add 15-minute 'buffers' between every back-to-back meeting.
Identify and resolve one scheduling conflict where two events overlap.
Present the final schedule in a clear weekly view.
deliverables: A PDF showing the weekly calendar view and a list of time-zone overlaps.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the accuracy of the time-zone conversions.

title: CRM Data Cleansing and Contact Management
short_description: Standardize and clean a messy list of business contacts for a sales team.
business_problem: Incorrectly formatted names and missing emails in a contact list lead to failed marketing campaigns.

instruction.overview: Clean a provided list of 20 unformatted contacts, ensuring all names, emails, and phone numbers follow a standard style.
steps: Convert all names to 'Proper Case' (e.g., JOHN DOE to John Doe).
Check for and remove any duplicate entries in the list.
Format all phone numbers to a consistent (XXX) XXX-XXXX format.
Validate that every entry has a '@' symbol in the email column.
Add a column for 'Country' based on the phone number area code.
deliverables: A cleaned spreadsheet with 20 validated contact entries.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Check for consistency in formatting across all rows.

title: Business Research and Competitor Briefing Report
short_description: Conduct research on three competitors and summarize findings for a management team.
business_problem: Small businesses need to understand their competitors' pricing and services but lack the time for deep research.

instruction.overview: Research three local or online competitors in a specific niche and create a comparison report.
steps: Choose a niche (e.g., 'Eco-friendly cleaning services' or 'Online tutoring').
Find 3 competitors and record their primary service, pricing, and social media presence.
Identify one 'Strength' and one 'Weakness' for each competitor.
Note a market trend that all three are following.
Write a 300-word summary recommending how your client can stand out.
deliverables: A 3-page competitor briefing report in PDF format.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on how well the data is synthesized into actionable advice.

title: Social Media Content Scheduling and Planning
short_description: Create a 2-week social media calendar for a small brand's Instagram and LinkedIn.
business_problem: Brands without a posting plan often have inconsistent engagement and low visibility.

instruction.overview: Draft a 14-day posting schedule including captions, hashtags, and visual suggestions for two platforms.
steps: Identify the brand's target audience and tone of voice.
Create 14 post entries with date, platform, and post type (e.g., Image, Reel, Poll).
Write engaging captions for each post (max 100 words per caption).
Research and include 5-10 relevant hashtags for every entry.
Suggest a specific stock photo or design concept for each post.
deliverables: A 2-week content calendar spreadsheet.
starter_resources: Social media post ideas for businesses
instruction.evaluation_notes: Captions should be creative and prompt user interaction (Call to Action).

title: Customer Support FAQ and Template Manual
short_description: Develop a set of standardized responses for a customer service help desk.
business_problem: Slow and inconsistent customer service responses damage a company's reputation.

instruction.overview: Create a manual for a support agent including common FAQs and templates for different scenarios.
steps: Brainstorm 10 'Frequently Asked Questions' for an e-commerce store.
Write clear, helpful answers for all 10 FAQs.
Create 5 email templates for: Order Tracking, Damaged Item, Refund Request, Late Shipping, and General Inquiry.
Outline a 'Escalation Flow' (when to pass a ticket to a manager).
Draft a short 'Style Guide' on how to sign off emails.
deliverables: A comprehensive customer support manual.
starter_resources: How to write an effective FAQ
instruction.evaluation_notes: Evaluate based on the helpfulness and politeness of the responses.

title: Visual Business Expense and Budget Tracker
short_description: Create an automated spreadsheet to track and visualize monthly business spending.
business_problem: Business owners often lose track of small expenses, leading to inaccurate tax filings and budget overruns.

instruction.overview: Develop a spreadsheet that automatically calculates totals and displays spending trends in charts.
steps: Create an 'Expenses' tab with columns for Date, Category, Vendor, and Amount.
Use a 'Data Validation' dropdown for categories (e.g., Software, Rent, Ads).
Build a 'Dashboard' tab with a formula to sum expenses by category.
Add a Pie Chart showing the % of spending by category.
Add a Bar Chart showing total spending per month for a 6-month period (use dummy data).
Write a 1-page guide on how a user should enter their data.
deliverables: An automated spreadsheet with charts and a user guide.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Formulas must be accurate and charts should be visually clean.

title: New Client Onboarding Process Map
short_description: Design a structured workflow for onboarding new clients into a service business.
business_problem: A disorganized onboarding process creates a poor first impression and delays project starts.

instruction.overview: Create a visual flowchart and task list for a seamless 14-day client onboarding experience.
steps: Define 4 distinct stages (e.g., Contract, Kickoff, Implementation, First Review).
Map the flow using a design tool (Canva, Figma, or Lucidchart).
Specify the automated emails sent at each stage.
Create a checklist of internal tasks (e.g., 'Set up Slack channel').
Add 'Conditional Logic' (e.g., 'If payment is late, send reminder').
deliverables: A visual onboarding flowchart and a detailed task checklist.
submission_requirements: Submit as a single PNG or PDF.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The process must be logical and easy for a client to follow.

title: Python Script for Daily Briefing Automation
short_description: Write a basic script to gather and format news or updates into a daily text report.
business_problem: Executives waste time browsing multiple news sites for industry updates every morning.

instruction.overview: Create a Python script that takes a list of sample updates and formats them into a clean text file briefing.
steps: Define a list of dictionary items containing 'Title', 'Source', and 'Summary'.
Write a function to format each item into a professional bullet-point style.
Include a header with the current date.
Export the final formatted briefing to a .txt file automatically.
Include a README explaining how to run the script and add new data.
deliverables: A ZIP file containing the Python script and a sample output briefing.
submission_requirements: Code projects must be submitted as one .zip upload only.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The script should run without errors and produce a readable text file.

title: Flash Fiction Trio: Concise Storytelling
short_description: Write three distinct micro-stories under 100 words each exploring different themes.
business_problem: In modern digital media, writers must capture attention quickly and convey deep meaning within strict word limits.

instruction.overview: You will produce three micro-stories that each tell a complete narrative within 100 words.
steps: Select three contrasting themes (e.g., hope, betrayal, discovery).
Draft a first story focusing on a surprising twist ending.
Write a second story using sensory imagery to describe a single moment.
Write a third story using only dialogue between two characters.
Edit all stories to ensure they are strictly under 100 words each.
deliverables: A single document containing all three stories.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the emotional impact achieved with very few words.

criteria.label: Correctness
criteria.description: Meets word count and theme requirements.

title: The Protagonist's Blueprint
short_description: Create a detailed character profile and a sample internal monologue.
business_problem: Weak character development leads to flat narratives that fail to engage readers or viewers.

instruction.overview: Develop a complex character from scratch and demonstrate their unique voice through an internal monologue.
steps: Complete a character sheet including physical traits, fears, and a core secret.
Define the character's primary goal and the obstacle standing in their way.
Write a 300-word internal monologue of the character reacting to a stressful situation.
Ensure the 'voice' in the monologue reflects the personality defined in the sheet.
deliverables: Character profile sheet and a 300-word internal monologue.
instruction.evaluation_notes: The monologue should reveal character traits through thoughts rather than direct description.

title: Dual Verse Poetry Collection
short_description: Write two poems comparing nature and urban life using different structural styles.
business_problem: Poetry requires a balance of rigid structure and emotional fluidity, a key skill for professional copy and creative arts.

instruction.overview: Produce two poems: one strictly structured (like a Haiku or Sonnet) and one in free verse.
steps: Choose an urban setting for your first poem and a natural setting for the second.
Write a structured poem (e.g., a Haiku) about the urban environment.
Write a free-verse poem about the natural environment using rich metaphors.
Review both poems to ensure they contrast effectively in both theme and structure.
deliverables: A document containing both poems.
submission_requirements: Submit as a PDF or Word document.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Focus on the use of vivid, sensory language.

title: The Art of the Dialogue Scene
short_description: Write a 2-page scene driven entirely by dialogue to reveal conflict.
business_problem: Over-reliance on description can slow down a story; writers must learn to advance the plot through speech alone.

instruction.overview: Create a scene where two characters have a disagreement, using only their spoken words to show the setting and tension.
steps: Define two characters with opposing immediate goals.
Set the scene (e.g., a crowded bus, a quiet library) through dialogue cues only.
Write a 2-page script where the tension escalates.
Avoid using 'he said/she said' more than 5 times; let the speech identify the speaker.
Include a moment where what is NOT said is more important than what is said.
deliverables: A 2-page dialogue scene.
instruction.evaluation_notes: Ensure the dialogue sounds natural and avoids 'info-dumping'.

title: The Catalyst: Short Story Writing
short_description: Write a 1,000-word short story focused on a single 'Inciting Incident'.
business_problem: Stories often meander; learning to focus on the catalyst that sets a plot in motion is vital for narrative structure.

instruction.overview: Draft a complete short story where a specific event changes the protagonist's world immediately.
steps: Outline a simple 3-act structure (Setup, Conflict, Resolution).
Write the opening scene establishing the 'normal' life of the character.
Introduce the inciting incident within the first 200 words.
Show the character's reaction and their first attempt to fix the problem.
Conclude with a clear resolution or a cliffhanger.
Keep the total word count at approximately 1,000 words.
deliverables: A 1,000-word short story.
